title: Examining the factors influencing academic performance of medical technology students in e-learning: A questionnaire survey
reason: Questionnaire study (MSLQ motivation, learning approaches, burnout) correlated with academic performance within grade bands among 37 e-learning students. Predictors are self-report; no platform-recorded indicator or activity product is analysed.

extraction.country: Taiwan (Chang Gung University / Chang Gung Memorial Hospital; author affiliations)
extraction.design: cross-sectional survey, Kruskal-Wallis and Spearman correlation
extraction.n_quote: This study conducted a quantitative sur- ... vey on 37 medical technology students.
extraction.population: medical technology undergraduates in an e-learning course, 1 university
extraction.outcome_or_construct: academic performance (grade); self-reported motivation (MSLQ), learning approaches, burnout
extraction.notes: Correlations are self-report ↔ grade within small subgroups (e.g. self-efficacy r = 0.858 in middle-grade group, n = 11); not indicator relations. The abstract gives self-efficacy p = 0.047 while the text gives p = 0.028 for r = -0.502.
